items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Joe Marsala in the context of Buddy Rich's early career ('Buddy Rich came up in that old school way back there with Joe Marsala...'). The interviewee (Cozy Cole) does not respond to this specific mention or claim any personal connection to Joe Marsala.

ctx.x: What do you think about ... like that?

Well as far as the music is concerned, I've always said there is some good rock and there's some bad rock. The same way when the swing or the be-bop era was in, there was some good be-bop and there was some bad and that goes the same way with the music. Now as far as these drummers are concerned, there's Elvin Jones has got a very nice name, he happens to be one of the good ones. Some drummers that try to play like Elvin is very bad, they sound bad. And I would say that it runs in cycles like that. If you're…
Alvin used to play, I guess....
